open_points.subject: kernel configuration path command-line intake
open_points.text: The kernel reads the file's path, an absolute one or the kernel refuses to start, from its one command-line argument — with none or more than one it refuses to start too
open_points.question: Which module owns reading the kernel process command line and refusing zero, multiple, or non-absolute configuration-path arguments: `surface`, `installation`, or another module?
options: `surface` parses the process command line and passes the validated absolute path to `installation.load_installation`
`installation.load_installation` reads and validates the process command line itself
A separate process-entry module owns command-line parsing and passes the path to `installation`
open_points.default_guess: `surface` parses the single command-line argument and passes the absolute path to `installation.load_installation`.
